def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    vals=Counter(v for r in g for v in r if v!=bg)
    lc=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mrows=sorted({i for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,lc)})
    mcols=sorted({j for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,lc)})
    M=[[g[i][j] for j in mcols] for i in mrows]
    R,C=len(mrows),len(mcols)
    out=[]
    for i in range(R-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(C-1):
            s={M[i][j],M[i][j+1],M[i+1][j],M[i+1][j+1]}
            row.append(s.pop() if len(s)==1 and next(iter(s))!=lc else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
